milestones.title: Key access types are reviewed against the ACP-240 edition your organization receives

remediation: Partners have no post-quantum key type, so key access at the boundary is classical (RSA or P-256), which a future quantum computer could open from a recording. Each export records the key access algorithm, the export dialog says so, and your organization's security officer can set the highest level a partner may receive that way. The security officer accepts this condition for each partner. Source: .planning/phases/45.2-nato-and-five-eyes-exchange-part-2-ztdf-and-the-nato-texts/45.2-CONTEXT.md D-12 and D-13.
title: Partners without post-quantum support get classical key access only
